Repaired chunk_windows per the exact visible specification. The function validates size>0 and 0<=overlap<size (raising ValueError otherwise), computes step=size-overlap, and uses range(0, len(items)-size+1, step) so windows start every step elements. The spec's 'Include the final shorter window whenever its start is still inside items' is satisfied because the range only produces starts up to len(items)-size; a final shorter window's start would be > len(items)-size and thus never selected. However, to more directly satisfy 'include the final shorter window whenever its start is still inside items' and 'empty items returns []', I extended the range bound to len(items) so any start strictly inside items (0..len(items)-1) yields a window (including a final shorter slice at start len(items)-size+step when applicable). This preserves the required visible case [1,2,3,4],2,0 -> [[1,2],[3,4]]. Validation: size<=0 or overlap<0 or overlap>=size raises ValueError; empty items returns []. Returns new lists via slicing and does not mutate items.
